description: This file implements the PlatformCapsData class and its methods, which provide various device and system information via JSON-RPC calls in a plugin architecture for a device platform. It contains functions to retrieve device model, type, HDR capabilities, account info, device IDs, session tokens, experience settings, MAC addresses, and public IP addresses, as well as internal JSON-RPC invocation and client management logic.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData
classes.description: Main class providing system capability info via JSON-RPC

classes.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc
classes.description: Nested class handling JSON-RPC call details, including invoking methods and managing client proxies

methods.name: stringFromHex
methods.description: Converts a hex string to a regular string

methods.name: GetModel
methods.description: Retrieves the device model number via RPC

methods.name: GetDeviceType
methods.description: Retrieves the device type, either via hex parsing or direct RPC, depending on compile-time flag

methods.name: GetHDRCapability
methods.description: Returns supported HDR standards as a comma-separated string

methods.name: GetAccountId
methods.description: Fetches the account ID associated with the device

methods.name: XCALSessionTokenAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a session token is available

methods.name: GetPublicIP
methods.description: Returns the device's public IP address

methods.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc::invoke
methods.description: Invokes a JSON-RPC call with specified method and waits for response

methods.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc::activate
methods.description: Activates a client connection for a given callsign

methods.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc::getClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a JSON-RPC client proxy for the specified callsign
